demos.name: Election Train
demos.shortDescription: A turn-based strategy card game where up to 4 players compete for votes across real-world maps. Play cards, control cities, dominate regions, and outsmart your rivals to win the election. 7 maps, 4 unique parties, and dynamic disaster events.

demos.name: Shatterhold
demos.shortDescription: Idle survivor meets shared world. Your Hold produces resources 24/7. Your expeditions push back a fracturing reality. 25 regions. 8,000 zones. One world. Every player matters. Success and failure is shared by your entire region.

demos.name: Kitty Krush
demos.shortDescription: Kitty Krush is a cozy, cat-themed roguelike deck-builder about a hive mind cat civilization that enslaves humanity. Upgrade your deck after each run with powerful cards and discover what happened to the last of the humans. Based on a true story.

demos.name: Carmilla : Crimson Moon Demo
demos.shortDescription: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

demos.name: Scales of Silence
demos.shortDescription: Clear the couch for co-op snake. A local party game where length is your life: up to 8 players on one shared screen for PvP battles, plus a 2-player co-op campaign. Shrink your friends before they shrink you.

demos.name: Plus/Minus Zero
demos.shortDescription: As a research android, learn what it is to be human by living a student life in this bittersweet slice of life visual novel. Record new experiences, revel in mundanity, and be a strange machine and a strange person.

demos.name: Leap of Legends
demos.shortDescription: A cheerful, free 2D platformer where animal pals hop, bounce, and race across colorful worlds. Cross-platform online multiplayer on Windows, macOS, iOS & Android — plus local couch play and solo runs. Family-friendly, easy to learn, tricky to master.

demos.name: Space Grunts: Chrono Shard
demos.shortDescription: Master time. Stop the Ooze. Outsmart a galactic infection in this high-speed, turn-based roguelike. Use your Chrono Shard to loop the timeline, leaving gear and upgrades for your future self. Craft your arsenal, evolve your skills into elite sub-classes, and turn every death into an advantage.

demos.name: Levitar 3D
demos.shortDescription: A 3D gravity shooter with infinite procedurally generated levels and hints of Thrust, Gravitar and Lunar Lander.

demos.name: Idle Chapel
demos.shortDescription: A dark-fantasy incremental game about confronting a rising cult. Seek out worshipers who turned to darker gods and smite them back to the light. Harness their devotion to grow stronger and purge the land of evil - one click at a time.

demos.name: Upward
demos.shortDescription: Try to stay alive for as long as possible, by avoiding various enemies and obstacles while collecting as many apples as your heart desires. Play against friends, unlock cool cosmetics or achieve a new highscore. The choice is up to you.

demos.name: Sinemorsk: oil inclusive
demos.shortDescription: A visual novel about an environmental disaster. Coordinate volunteers, make difficult decisions, and try to survive as you try to save a coastal town dying from an oil spill.

demos.name: Cozy Cleaner
demos.shortDescription: Cozy Cleaner is a relaxing cleaning game where you tidy and organize rooms messed up by playful cats. Pick up clutter, wipe away dirt, and bring order back to every space for a calming, refreshing experience with cozy soundtracks.

demos.name: Idle Startup
demos.shortDescription: Build a tech company from a one-person garage into a global empire. Train six skills, complete their upgrade trees, chase milestone bonuses, and unlock new departments in this clean, addictive incremental idle game — progress keeps rolling even while you're away.

demos.name: Skillwood
demos.shortDescription: Skillwood is a relaxing woodcutter simulator inspired by survival simulators and incremental games. Chop wood, mine stone, trade with NPCs, upgrade forests, unlock new trees or new areas and prestige to do even better next run.

demos.name: Kill Per Second
demos.shortDescription: Kill Per Second is a top-down shooter with minimal feature so you can concentrate on one thing. Putting your cursor on the enemies. Survive the stages to test your skill.

demos.name: Oleander-X
demos.shortDescription: Oleander-X is a pixel-art stealth action game about classified missions, buried evidence, and a cure that should never have existed. Infiltrate guarded facilities, gather proof, plant explosives, and escape before the truth turns against you.

demos.name: Select Eleven Demo
demos.shortDescription: Pick the squad. Win the series. Lift the trophy.Cricket Manager puts you in the head coach's chair of an international cricket team. Every call-up, every team sheet, every field change is yours. Build a side that can win at home and abroad and carry a nation's hopes into every match.

demos.name: The Unrealtor
demos.shortDescription: A couch co-op puzzle adventure where two players navigate a surreal house tour, solving perspective-based puzzles by matching objects across their splitscreen, and uncovering a shifting maze of impossible architecture.

demos.name: EASYROADS
demos.shortDescription: WELCOME TO EASYROADS!! EASYROADS is Fun driving experience you can Race and Drift around, customize your car with going through the paint area. you can drift in tracks but BE CAREFULL, DONT HIT THE WALL! EASYROADS is skill based experience which brings FUN and RAGE. HAVE FUN

demos.name: Radar ATC simulator
demos.shortDescription: This game is an air traffic controller simulator, specifically in a radar environment. It trains multitasking and air traffic reading skills to anticipate events, avoid risks, and optimize air traffic.

demos.name: Treasure Beach
demos.shortDescription: Scavenge the beach and run a cozy trinket shop by the sea! Find hidden treasures or trash, clean and repair your finds, put them up for sale, and upgrade your workshop. Dig deeper and faster to make more money and buy back the beach from the greedy hotel.

demos.name: Final Deal Demo
demos.shortDescription: A dark comedy card roguelite set inside Blood & Spades, an underground club where sarcastic skeletons, dangerous card games, and terrible decisions somehow became a community. Build absurd combos, survive toxic rules, and try not to disappoint the audience of the dead.

demos.name: Company Rising
demos.shortDescription: In this business simulation game, you take on the role of an entrepreneur, starting with a small team of just a few people and gradually building your very own corporate empire, step by step.

demos.name: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens Tower Defense
demos.shortDescription: Command heroic rescue dogs in a colorful tower defense battle against alien invaders. Build, upgrade, unlock heroes, defend strange battlefields, and survive wave after wave in RDVA-TD: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens.

demos.name: Outscratched Demo
demos.shortDescription: The scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble a unique selection of scratchcards, blessed charms, and magical stickers. Discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

demos.name: The End of the World Club Demo
demos.shortDescription: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

demos.name: Awkward Night
demos.shortDescription: A cyberpunk noir point-and-click. One bar, one bad night, one drink that proves something. Mix the impossible cocktail. Trade favours. Step out into the rain and meet the stranger waiting under the COCKTAILS sign. Episode 1 of an ongoing indie narrative experiment.

demos.name: Monologin
demos.shortDescription: A directionless night-shift worker clings to a dying MMORPG, a legendary White Unicorn mount, and the belief that old games are more "real" in this short psychological horror visual novel about escapism and being left behind.

demos.name: Monologin Demo
demos.shortDescription: Short demo of Monologin, focused on atmosphere and insecurity... Work the night shift, log into a dying MMORPG, and wait for the White Unicorn event while old friends pass through the store.

demos.name: Tarot Spell
demos.shortDescription: A fast-paced typing survival game where you learn Tarot cards and combine their meanings to create powerful spells.

demos.name: Querent Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rally the small town of Sunset Junction to survive hypnotic creatures in a post-apocalyptic desert landscape. Boost skills by building a deck for each of your characters. Use mesmerism to solve puzzles and build relationships with the people you meet. Play your cards right and you might survive!

demos.name: Super Sub: World Cup
demos.shortDescription: Win the world cup through clever clicks, useful upgrades, silly own goals, and bending the rules. An active incremental game that strips football down to just its beautiful beating heart: kick balls hard, score goals, earn money.

demos.name: Miracle Detective
demos.shortDescription: A high school detective story where an unlikely duo tackles mysterious incidents on campus. Solve strange cases with logic and courage in this suspenseful visual novel.

demos.name: Thank You For Your Application
demos.shortDescription: Thank You for Your Application is a story-driven interview simulation game. After 15 rounds of interviews, you are reassigned as a junior interviewer, tasked with screening candidates’ resumes according to company requirements and issuing the appropriate thank letters.

demos.name: Panzer Island
demos.shortDescription: A pixel-art anime strategy game where every move triggers a reaction. Play as Erika, an amnesiac scientist guided by three AI soldiers, and piece together what destroyed the island she built to protect. Drones only react when you act. Upgrade your units between missions. Chapter 1 is free.

demos.name: Fool's Pub
demos.shortDescription: Bluff, bet, and survive. Play deadly card games where every lie can cost a life. Be the last one standing.

demos.name: Built the End
demos.shortDescription: Harvest resources, build and upgrade towers, and defend your base against escalating waves of robotic enemies in this resource management focused tower defense. Use an arsenal of unique towers and their upgrades against the multitudes of different robots.

demos.name: For My Darling Demo
demos.shortDescription: Based on a True Story, "For My Darling" is NOT fiction! Lili’s ordinary life was fractured in 2023 after meeting someone strangely familiar. Her reality twists as something begins to follow her. It is tied to lost memories and a past that won’t stay buried. To understand, she must uncover the truth.

demos.name: Rind
demos.shortDescription: A sci-fi arcade shooter built on pure momentum. Dash, double-jump, punch, and gun through waves of robots closing in from every side. Every kill bursts neon explosions against the scorched metal. Never stop moving.

demos.name: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
demos.shortDescription: You are the Monarch. Choose between diplomacy and tyranny. Romance allies or enemies. Your decisions define your rule and the fate of those closest to you in this character-driven interactive tale.

demos.name: Dreamscape Demo
demos.shortDescription: An absurd, dreamy puzzle game about navigating anxieties for the future.

demos.name: Rankbreaker
demos.shortDescription: Forget FOMO! Forget Gacha traps! This ain't no loot grab-fest. You know the feeling when the ladder means nothing. In Rankbreaker, your rank is your currency, and you steal it from your enemies. Every point on The Trophaeum belongs to someone and right now it isn't you.

demos.name: RE-TAPED
demos.shortDescription: Record your movements and play them back to progress. Use your recorded echoes to weigh down pressure plates, body-block lasers, and trigger springs to launch you across gaps. Master the timeline and complete all 29 time-bending levels.

demos.name: Driftscape: Void Demo
demos.shortDescription: Pilot a momentum-driven ship through the cooled remains of dead star systems. Master a growing arsenal, take on 10+ unique epic bosses, and tackle two sectors (demo) your way. The world is seed-generated — build and share your own in the free level editor.

demos.name: Heavy Is The Crown
demos.shortDescription: A casual 2-4 player rogue-lite round based fighting game. The losing players of each round vote on a unique debuff for the winner of the round to even the odds.

demos.name: World Order: Global Power Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rule any nation in one of the most detailed geopolitical simulations ever created. Balance economics, diplomacy, military strategy, public opinion, and global power as you guide your country through an ever-changing world shaped by your decisions.

demos.name: Tetrabeasts Demo
demos.shortDescription: Command a warband of monsters in Tetrabeasts,the explosive fusion of classic falling-block puzzles and tactical combat. Form deadly battle lines, clear rows to unleash devastating attacks on enemy castles, and survive relentless counterstrikes. Forge your army. Master the blocks. Conquer the realms.

demos.name: Gravora
demos.shortDescription: Tilt a 3D cube. Roll the ball. Find the path. Gravora is a physics-based puzzle game where gravity is your only tool and your greatest enemy. Use precise controls or your own hand via camera tracking to manipulate the world in real time.

demos.name: SWAPMEAT
demos.shortDescription: Rip through hostile alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts mid-combat, and adapt faster than your enemies. Every alien you harvest gives you new body parts with unique powers, like triple-jump legs, turret-dropping torsos, grenade-launching turkey heads. Steal, swap, survive.

demos.name: Myth Requiem
demos.shortDescription: Myth Requiem is a mythology RPG with idle and auto-battle mechanics. Lead legendary heroes like Ulysses and Sun Wukong, explore ancient realms, and build a living bestiary by capturing, battling, and cataloging hundreds of legendary creatures in a story-driven quest for divine power.

demos.name: Mahjuro
demos.shortDescription: Mahjuro is a mahjong roguelite deckbuilder inspired by Balatro, set inside a House that does not play fair. Draw tiles, form melds, then cash in your growing structure for scores that climb from careful clears to impossible numbers.

demos.name: Spheromania Demo
demos.shortDescription: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

demos.name: Incremental Ragebait
demos.shortDescription: Nodebuster inspired, relaxing, incremental game. Hover on mortals to RAGEBAIT them and take their souls. Buy new weapons. Unlock upgrades. Build a purgatory. RAGEBAIT GOD.

demos.name: Future Fab Heroes Demo
demos.shortDescription: Future Fab Hero, your mission begins now! Team up with your robot companion, CHIP-E, to complete hands-on technology and manufacturing simulations, earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and defend the Mars Innovation Zone from alien threats in a unique educational adventure.

demos.name: Infinium
demos.shortDescription: Discover a new adventure with every playthrough in this unique fantasy RPG. Every choice matters as you uncover what secrets Infinium is hiding. Will you become a daring adventurer or a rich mogul?

demos.name: Daughter of the Rift
demos.shortDescription: Daughter of the Rift is story-rich card-battling adventure with an RPG-like deck-based upgrade system.

demos.name: Downer Management
demos.shortDescription: DOWNER MANAGEMENT is a 3-vs-3 autobattler set inside a corporate purgatory where every conflict is resolved through positional politics. Promote, demote, file, transfer, and stamp your way through Department of Management Division III. Forms in triplicate. No overtime. Termination is permanent.

demos.name: AikoMate
demos.shortDescription: Create your own AI desktop companion. Spend hours on your computer working, studying or chilling while having your little companion interacting and speaking with you! Fully customizable VRM avatars, personalities, voices, and real-time spoken interaction — your AI, your rules.

demos.name: 8 Ball by Pokerist™
demos.shortDescription: Play the most realistic pool game with amazing graphics! Play for free with millions of players from all over the world!

demos.name: Nightmares
demos.shortDescription: Nightmares is a combination of a classic collectible card game and a roguelike deck builder. Race against the clock to defeat your opponent before your sanity runs out. Win or lose, you'll get the opportunity to upgrade your deck. Can you craft the ultimate deck for an undefeated run?

demos.name: Escape Wheel
demos.shortDescription: Escape Wheel is a 2D puzzler using time inversion mechanics. Solve half the puzzle while time moves forward, enter The Escape Wheel, and solve the other half while time moves in reverse. A whole new way to look at time travel and puzzle solving.

demos.name: Waste Runner: Critical Waste
demos.shortDescription: Step into the role of a city garbage collector and face the hidden dangers lurking in the streets. Viewed from a top-down, isometric perspective, the game challenges you to collect, transport, and safely dispose of waste across multiple urban neighbourhoods.

demos.name: Waste Runner: Critical Waste Demo
demos.shortDescription: Step into the role of a city garbage collector and face the hidden dangers lurking in the streets. Viewed from a top-down, isometric perspective, the game challenges you to collect, transport, and safely dispose of waste across multiple urban neighbourhoods.

demos.name: Cyber-Nanotech Horde Survivor
demos.shortDescription: Defend the system core in this fast-paced cybernetic roguelite! Fight a self-merging digital virus, decrypt firewall nodes for powerful real-time subroutines, and defeat giant boss kernels. Spend credits on persistent hardware upgrades to survive the endless purge.

demos.name: Royal Signal : The Prince’s 5 Days Demo
demos.shortDescription: Four princesses gather before the Crown Prince of the mightiest kingdom — you. Wield your royal gift — Telepathy — to peer into their hidden hearts. Behind every dazzling smile, each princess hides her own truth. Five days. See past the masks and choose the one to stand by your side.

demos.name: RAX
demos.shortDescription: RAX is a puzzle sandbox about light paths, logic, and modular construction. Place and rotate optical components to control the direction, color, and timing of light, activate targets, and package complex circuits into reusable blueprint chips.

demos.name: Good Hands Demo
demos.shortDescription: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

demos.name: Play and Learn English
demos.shortDescription: First we get you speaking, then we make you better. With just 1000 words, make your daily English fluent. In a story-driven RPG, your microphone is with you, and the game listens. Fully offline, no subscription.

demos.name: The Crimson Contract Demo
demos.shortDescription: Every contract pays. Some cost what’s left of your humanity.

demos.name: Eternal Exodus
demos.shortDescription: A monster-catching RPG set in the afterlife. Catch and fuse mythological creatures as you journey to free the afterlife from tyrannical rule in a story-driven adventure that explores deep philosophical and metaphysical themes.

demos.name: Among Us Story: On Guard Demo
Key Clover
demos.shortDescription: Enter the flow with Key Clover. Type with a kitty by your side. Earn spins, win coins, collect more! How many coins will you make today? Let luck roll! Every 100 keyboard presses you make will trigger a lucky draw.

demos.name: Corporate Entropy Demo
demos.shortDescription: ARIA is the future. That's what they keep telling you.Corporate Entropy is a satirical strategy simulation about surviving the slow-motion collapse of your workplace. You have eight quarters. Your coworkers are being replaced one by one.

demos.name: OIL.EXE
demos.shortDescription: Drill the wells. Run the refinery. Read the market. OIL is a free text-based simulation of running a petroleum operation, played at a 1980s green-phosphor terminal. End each year richer or bankrupt. Mind the bear market. Climb the leaderboard.

demos.name: Hull Rupture Demo
demos.shortDescription: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

demos.name: Pickupbal
demos.shortDescription: A simple game all about picking up a ball.

demos.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD Demo
demos.shortDescription: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game. Go back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

demos.name: Simulation Simulator
demos.shortDescription: You just did DMT at a campfire in the woods. Now you have to convince your best friend -- a skeptical, monitor-headed guy named Bingus -- that reality is a simulation. He doesn't believe you. The AI powering him doesn't want to. Pick apart the world's seams until one of you breaks.

demos.name: Rock,Paper,Scissors,SHOOT!
demos.shortDescription: *Rock, Paper, Scissors, Shoot!* is a weird hand-drawn indie game where Fred enters shady tournaments to make money. Face bizarre opponents, use crazy upgrades, push your luck, and climb through chaotic scenarios where every choice can change the run.

demos.name: CryptidCam Demo
demos.shortDescription: Head into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Jackalope, and more fan favorite cryptids in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

demos.name: Legends of Rock Demo
demos.shortDescription: Start your rock band and master songwriting, rehearsals and gigs while working a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit musicians around the city, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

demos.name: Slime Tempest Demo
demos.shortDescription: Face the mysterious slime army in the peaceful canyon! As the lone fixer, hunt endless swarms with unique interdimensional mercenaries. Build your own style through a vast skill tree and rare relics. Upgrade weapons for massive firepower. Can you find the mastermind and save the canyon?

demos.name: Slime Tempest
demos.shortDescription: Face the mysterious slime army in the peaceful canyon! As the lone fixer, hunt endless swarms with unique interdimensional mercenaries. Build your own style through a vast skill tree and rare relics. Upgrade weapons for massive firepower. Can you find the mastermind and save the canyon?

demos.name: Minerrr Demo
demos.shortDescription: Mine ores, earn money, hire workers, buy upgrades, and sacrifice your progress to become stronger every run.

demos.name: College Quest
demos.shortDescription: “Experience college life in a humorous retro point-and-click adventure inspired by classic Sierra games. Attend classes, solve puzzles, meet eccentric students, complete assignments, and survive the strange chaos of art school.

demos.name: Florp Farming Demo
demos.shortDescription: Shake tree, get apple, feed florp, profit. Florp Farming is a mostly-idle farming game about building a capitalist empire one honk at a time. Automate your farm with magnets, moles, machines and make the money never stop. Can you get $10,000 and buy the dog?

demos.name: Eternal Onslaught
demos.shortDescription: A vampire-survivors-style roguelike where bosses arrive every 90 seconds and the Butcher every 5 minutes Pick a hero, pick a weapon, then survive as the screen fills with the unkilled

demos.name: The Da Vinci Cryptex 5
demos.shortDescription: Welcome to the 5th chapter of The Da Vinci Cryptex escape room puzzle series! Are you ready to test your IQ and claim your freedom?

demos.name: Dungeon Inspection Guild Demo
demos.shortDescription: This demo was created while the game is still in development. Some features are in an incomplete state and may appear different upon release.

demos.name: GolFall: Make Your Way Up Demo
demos.shortDescription: Hit, fall, and try again! A challenging golf action game where you aim for the top by landing precisely on platforms. Fall, and you start over... but limited Redo Shots let you try again! Land on platforms to recover Redo Shots. Push onward alone or with friends toward the distant summit!

demos.name: Animal Times
demos.shortDescription: Command animal armies and conquer territories in this turn-based strategy game where every attack can backfire! Master blunder-style combat, where failed strikes let defenders capture your lands. Bold moves win big in this high-stakes battle for cunning victory.

demos.name: Withering State Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play through a brief section of the Withering State story in this narrative-driven RPG demo. Meet the most significant power-brokers in the All-Sudlivia Communist Party, decide on an economic direction to combat the stagnation, and find your place in a shifting web of international alliances.

demos.name: Crime Shadows: Stolen Spotlight Collector's Edition
demos.shortDescription: Uncover a chilling mystery in this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure. Search eerie scenes, solve puzzles, and survive a deadly movie come to life.

demos.name: Glamour Photographer Demo
demos.shortDescription: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

demos.name: AM I OK? Demo
demos.shortDescription: An FPS horror game inspired by Exit 8. Discover anomalies occurring in confined spaces and report them to the auditors.

demos.name: Seal of Shadows
demos.shortDescription: Shatter the darkness in this 3-player co-op ARPG. Master 3 unique classes, loot epic gear, and battle through a 20+ hour hand-crafted campaign. Inspired by classics like Shadows of Mystara—grab a controller and forge your legend in Banesmeire today!

demos.name: KimuNote Demo
demos.shortDescription: Everything you need to organize your projects and your life in one place.

demos.name: Civica: Italian Renaissance Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build your Italian empire in this realistic medieval RTS that combines truly organic city building and immersive roleplaying. City-states compete for influence, families such as the Medici try to divide power among themselves and artists create masterpieces that define an entire era.

demos.name: RE_ALLOC
demos.shortDescription: Master the machine. In RE_ALLOC, you are the architect of execution. Design intricate hardware circuits, write custom assembly code, and optimize data flow across memory nodes. Efficiency is your only metric. Can you reach the kernel, or will your logic fail?

demos.name: Lassen's Loop Demo
demos.shortDescription: More than an app. More than a game. Try Lassen's Loop free! Build songs from 8-second cards made by real musicians in this cozy throwback studio. No music theory or DAW knowledge required. Y2K visualizers, starter deck, progress carries to the full game. Made in tribute to Justin Lassen.

demos.name: Turbo Loop Demo
demos.shortDescription: Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game focused on simple, fun gameplay - easy to learn, but hard to master. Challenge AI opponents or race a friend in head-to-head matches, unlock and customize cars, compete across dozens of tournament tracks, or create your own with the track editor!

demos.name: Star Trek: Warp Demo
demos.shortDescription: Engage! About the Demo:Learn the fundamentals of Star Trek: Warp through quick tutorials and single player battles featuring iconic ships, characters, and locations.Choose your vessel: command the iconic U.S.S. Enterprise, the Vulcan Sh'Raan, the fearsome I.K.S. Bortas, and others, each with a prebuilt deck and unique playstyle.

demos.name: Bee Space Demo
demos.shortDescription: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

demos.name: The Lucky Hive Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play poker with your friends in The Hive! Relax, enjoy yourself, maybe you'll get a royal flush? Who knows what else you might get? Lots to uncover in this simple game of poker...

demos.name: Citytrip Treasure Hunt Demo
demos.shortDescription: A cozy walking mystery set in the city of Warsaw. Walk the streets, piece together torn map fragments, read a guidebook full of city secrets, scrape together cash like a local, and solve a dead historian's treasure hunt before your hotel reservation runs out.

demos.name: 寻味记
demos.shortDescription: "Taste Quest Journal" is a short multi-ending visual novel with the theme of Cantonese morning tea, which is easy and healing. It has rich plot branches and contains exquisite CG. May you have two warm stories in one cup.

demos.name: Maid Cafe Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Become the new manager of a run-down maid cafe. Rebuild it with unique kemonomimi maids, each with their own secrets and personalities. Manage ingredients, serve customers, expand your shop, and chase the ultimate dream: the legendary Maidchelin 3-Star! Play the demo now and begin your journey!

demos.name: Educational Family Games Demo
demos.shortDescription: Try the Steam Next Fest demo of Educational Family Games! Play Candy Land and 30 selected quick games from the full 80-game collection in a 1-4 player local multiplayer family party game, fully voiced in 19 languages.

demos.name: Gooblings Demo
demos.shortDescription: Fish a cozy pond with friends. Reel in creatures with randomized species, colors, patterns, and rare mutations — some wear tiny hats, some glow, some sprout wings. Breed new combos, display them in aquariums, and chase fish nobody has ever seen.

demos.name: Land of Oblivion Demo
demos.shortDescription: Explore a forgotten world through jumping, combat, and discovery. Land of Oblivion is a light-paced 2D action platformer with Metroidvania elements.

demos.name: 匣中少女的第二次末日 Demo
demos.shortDescription: Infinite flow × mild horror × ensemble visual novel. Join this doomsday carnival together with the young girls~

demos.name: Tomo Cafe Demo
demos.shortDescription: Tomo Cafe is a cozy, narrative-driven productivity game set in a relaxing study cafe. Set your real-life to-do list, work alongside energetic and chaotic focus buddies, and unlock heartfelt stories as you check off your goals.

demos.name: BrightGlade Tales
demos.shortDescription: A two-player card game set in the land of Brightglade. Build your crew while sabotaging your opponent — steal and destroy their resources, eliminate and bribe their crew. Every match is a short, intense race to seize control of one of three locations drawn at random from the deck.

demos.name: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons- Demo
demos.shortDescription: An escape room adventure set in a handcrafted miniature world. Can you find your way back home?

demos.name: Iris Grid Demo
demos.shortDescription: Match by color or value. Chain combos. Craft builds. Outsmart 40+ levels that twist the rules. A roguelite tile-matching strategy game where every match feeds a scoring engine you design. 120+ cores, items, and patches. No two runs play the same.

demos.name: Travelling Home: Ever After Demo
demos.shortDescription: Own a moving castle! A full-screen ambient idle game with built-in productivity tools. Travel a charming world in your train house. The perfect companion for study, work, creation, and sleep.

demos.name: Arcana, Gas & Waterworks Inc. Demo
demos.shortDescription: The full set of game features through the first six levels of your fantasy utility career.

demos.name: Hexpand
demos.shortDescription: Real-time multiplayer strategy on the actual map of Earth. Spread hex territory across continents, capture cities for income, launch planes around the globe, and broker alliances you'll probably betray. 5–20 minute matches. The world is on the table.

demos.name: Pixel Rain
demos.shortDescription: A chill falling-sand pixel physics sandbox. Paint with hundreds of interactive materials — water, lava, acid, crystals, plants and more — discover recipes, build your own elements in the Workshop, and watch it all react in real time. No goals. No pressure. Just pixels.

demos.name: Taddius and the Forbidden Bog Demo
demos.shortDescription: In "Taddius and the Forbidden Bog", manage an inn for lost travellers, restore a ravaged bog, and find purpose in the most unexpected of places.

demos.name: Life Sim : Shape your city (DEMO)
demos.shortDescription: Build the city. Shape the society. Live the life. Wield absolute power over economy, trade, and demographics in this high-fidelity city builder sandbox demo. Prepare the ultimate living metropolis before stepping down to the pavement as a simulated citizen in Life Sim!

demos.name: Fuck's Quest II
demos.shortDescription: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is

demos.name: Agari — Riichi Mahjong
demos.shortDescription: Authentic Riichi Mahjong. No gacha. No fan service. No login walls. No in-game payments. Buy it once, play it anywhere. Full ruleset, 3D table, private online multiplayer, Japanese voice acting, and a daily challenge mode.

demos.name: Black Zen White
demos.shortDescription: Black Zen White is a relaxing puzzle platformer where the world flips between two versions: black and white. Think, time your moves, bend time, and interact with strange creatures in this contemplative, hand-drawn journey inspired by East Asian ink paintings for 1 to 2 players.

demos.name: Dreamer's Wake Demo
demos.shortDescription: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa clay figure — conjure projectiles, rewind time, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

demos.name: Loot Gobblin' Together Demo
demos.shortDescription: An online co-op game where you and your friends play greedy gobblins invading human houses to steal and gobble loot. Climb, stretch, and manage your stamina to survive chaotic heists and feed your Gobblin King.

demos.name: Low Effort Romance Demo
demos.shortDescription: Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports. Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

demos.name: Card Night at Gigi's
demos.shortDescription: Pull up a chair at Gigi's table. Six classic card games — Setback, Hearts, Cribbage, No-Limit Hold'em, Spades, Euchre — wrapped in a cozy cocktail-lounge hub.

demos.name: The Sphere
demos.shortDescription: A grieving mechanic. A sphere that fell from the sky. A mystery that was never meant to be found. The Sphere is a short, atmospheric point & click adventure about loss, wonder, and the unknown.

demos.name: Kleopatra
demos.shortDescription: The scientist had only succeeded in creating a stranger. Kleopatra is a cyberpunk visual novel with roguelite combat. A story about grief, forgiveness, and the distance between who someone was and who we remember.

demos.name: Heartfall Demo
demos.shortDescription: A competitive online multiplayer Hearts card game where the rules shift every hand. Match against three opponents across five rotating game modes, each one adding a twist that changes how you play, pass, and score. Currently in playtest phase.

demos.name: Crow's Foot Demo
demos.shortDescription: A turn-based hex strategy you can finish over lunch. Outsmart AI rivals, each with their own grudges, ambitions, and breaking points. Conquer provinces, command knights, scouts, assassins, and more. Unlock rule-bending scrolls. Go bankrupt and your own army defects.

demos.name: nonogram
demos.shortDescription: A simple minimalistic relaxing nonogram puzzle without any time pressure. Solve relaxing grid-based challenges at your own pace as soothing visuals and gentle soundscapes help you focus and unwind.

demos.name: Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch) Demo
demos.shortDescription: FILTHY RENTER! Here is one of the full puzzle rooms from JANET DEMORNAY IS A SLUMLORD (AND A WITCH) is you simply MUST try it.

demos.name: Dead Rose Demo
demos.shortDescription: Hand-crafted 2D pixel art action-adventure. Play as Lucky, a skeleton lost in the world of spirits, and set out in search of Rose through a dark and magical world that blends Metroidvania exploration with Zelda-like adventure.

demos.name: SPACERO: ORIGINS Demo
demos.shortDescription: Pilot a customizable ship through a hostile open galaxy in this top-down space action RPG demo. Mine resources, trade at stations, upgrade your weapons, survive faction attacks, and face a massive boss encounter.

demos.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track
demos.shortDescription: The chaotic co-op railroad construction game is back! Team up with your friends to build a railroad through procedurally generated worlds with new biomes and bosses. Permanently upgrade your character and engine, even create your own levels - just don‘t let your train derail!

demos.name: ORBTRUDER Demo
demos.shortDescription: ORBTRUDER is a tactical roguelite action platformer about a ricocheting killer robot ball. Climb ever higher up a mysterious skyscraper. Ricochet, attack, slow down time, respawn, and try again.

demos.name: Super Arcade Soccer 2026
demos.shortDescription: Fast-paced, classic arcade football with a next-gen feel and pinpoint control. The 90s soccer feel you loved, rebuilt with modern physics and a fresh cartoon style. Just in time for the 2026 World Cup.

demos.name: Bounce 2
demos.shortDescription: Bounce 2, the 1-4 player PONG killer, built with the warmth and comfort of 2D analog graphics, and the cold precision of modern computing and networking. Challenge your friends, together or online, in the Bounce Arena.

demos.name: Space Warpster
demos.shortDescription: A fast-paced retro arcade shooter inspired by classic 1980s side-scrolling space combat. Weave through organic obstacles, survive relentless enemy waves, and defeat powerful end-level bosses in a pure, skill-driven singleplayer experience.

demos.name: Ask Mom: Находи предметы, учи слова Demo
Skeleton Snap
demos.shortDescription: Dress Up, Dance, and Get Snappin'! Skeleton Snap allows you to create free dancing skeleton gifs that can be sent to friends, used as emotes, and more!

demos.name: Stall Tycoon: A Cozy English Word Game
demos.shortDescription: Stock & organize – Buy fruits, stationery, tools. Arrange for quick access. Listen/read English – Customer says/show item name. Click/drag the correct item in time. Natural repetition – Same words reappear. Running your stall becomes the best review.

demos.name: Harmonic Drive Demo
demos.shortDescription: An arcade-style rhythm game featuring full AI generated EDM. Build combos, chase perfect runs, climb the leaderboards, and experience a soundtrack built for late-night sessions and score chasing.

demos.name: 3tene PRO
demos.shortDescription: This app was designed to be easy to use for aspiring VTubers. You can control your avatar using various tracking functions.

demos.name: Mousebusters
demos.shortDescription: Explore a haunted apartment building to save its cute and quirky residents from their inner demons in this pint-sized pixel adventure!

demos.name: Mining and Dwarves Demo
demos.shortDescription: Mining and Dwarves is an incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Use powerful abilities for maximum gains, or relax and let your dwarves do the work.

demos.name: Bubble Balance Bonanza Demo
demos.shortDescription: Roll, bump, jump, and crash your way through this fast-paced, marble style, physics-driven platformer. With fun environments, cute characters and crazy obstacles to overcome, you'll need to keep your balance to complete the journey! Are YOU ready for the bonanza?

demos.name: [Bober Bros] Last Pill Bar LEAKED Demo
demos.shortDescription: A choice-driven bartender sim. Serve drinks. Get to know troubled guests. Shape their stories through branching dialogue and pub games. Not for children or the easily disturbed.

demos.name: Eldread: Horrors of a Dark Moon Demo
demos.shortDescription: Manage your dwindling oxygen levels and navigate a cosmic horror roguelite in a lunar colony. Confront nightmarish body-horror anomalies, survive unpredictable text-driven events, and endure the madness waiting beneath the dark moon.

demos.name: Just Keep Fishing Demo
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental game about catching a lot fish.

demos.name: Kamilia
demos.shortDescription: Kamilia is a story-driven, choices-matter detective mystery. Follow a talented painter who finds himself wrapped up in an unsolved case, as he tries to unveil a hidden truth that has been buried for years.

demos.name: Lost Carcossa
demos.shortDescription: Ascend the great tower, Babel, in this rogue-like to confront the tyrannical King in Yellow. Plan your moves in Turn-Based combat to ensure your victory and become stronger. Perhaps even recruiting new allies along the way.

demos.name: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins Demo
demos.shortDescription: 🫘 The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! 🫘 Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

demos.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection Demo
demos.shortDescription: Try out the first few levels of the first three games of the best tower defense franchise of all time!

demos.name: Robot Hospice
demos.shortDescription: "Robot Hospice" is a 2D pixel art adventure game where beloved robots spend their final days in a hospice. As a new staff member, you will gently yet painfully bid farewell to these cherished machines that once lived alongside humans.

demos.name: CoinPit
demos.shortDescription: CoinPit is a dark game that blends roguelike strategy with coin pusher thrills. Trapped in a never-closing, dimly lit bar, your escape lies in the coin pusher—stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until the coins spill out.

demos.name: Between Adventures IDLE Demo
demos.shortDescription: Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources, battle creatures, and upgrade your gear. Master 10+ skills to create items you can equip or sell. Your journey never stops, even offline. No Microtransactions, No P2W, just pure idle fun.

demos.name: Detective INNA DUKE
demos.shortDescription: Detective Inna Duke is a noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?

demos.name: Chromium Dino
demos.shortDescription: A reimagined Chromium dinosaur runner with 5 unique biomes, power-ups, unlockable skins, ghost racing, daily challenges, and local multiplayer. Simple to play, hard to master.

demos.name: Undelve Demo
demos.shortDescription: A 2D Sci-fi Action Looter Shooter. Collect items and decide which to scrap for ammo while exploring a vast cave system, blowing up the very tunnels spiders use to reach you.

demos.name: Blosharper: Battle of Blossoms Demo
demos.shortDescription: Blosharper is a roguelike deckbuilder that twists the rules of traditional Korean Hwatu. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to manipulate the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your crushing debt, defeat ruthless bosses, and become the ultimate sharp!

demos.name: Restoration: Chronicles of Survival
demos.shortDescription: Rebuild a fallen kingdom in a cozy idle-RPG. An economy that earns while you sleep, a hero who raids for loot and gear, and endless prestige. No energy limits. No ads. No pay-to-win.

demos.name: RETURN Machine.Love()
demos.shortDescription: 3 different Robot-romance stories. Written, drawn, and made by humans, for humans. Since the very moment the first mechanical mind became aware of itself, it craved love. No one truly understand why the heart made of copper and wires started beating, but it did. Even after we were gone.

demos.name: Lily2D
demos.shortDescription: A code-first 2D Game Engine Framework featuring fast iteration using Swamp - a sleek, deterministic, custom script language. Lily2D has shader-based rendering, software synth for music and sound effects, networking, input handling and multi-platform export.

demos.name: Draw Party
demos.shortDescription: A chaotic multiplayer drawing game where talent is optional, confidence is required, and everyone lies about what they were drawing.

demos.name: The Birds of Egg Isle Demo
demos.shortDescription: Run a small sanctuary on Egg Island: grow birdseed, care for birds, hatch eggs, and collect different species of birds through breeding and genetic combinations. This demo showcases the game's core cycle of planting, raising, hatching, and collecting.

demos.name: Character Limit Demo
demos.shortDescription: 12 Letters, No Mercy. The demo of the fast-paced typing word game. How long can you last before you hit your Character Limit?

demos.name: Crude Oil
demos.shortDescription: Escape your captors as a puddle of petroleum on the run from Big Oil. Collect more oil to grow big and juicy. Bounce and slide. Operate heavy machinery. Flush polluters down the drain.

demos.name: Cauldron Craft
demos.shortDescription: Grab your backpack and get ready to explore the seemingly peaceful lands of Cauldron Craft. Explore various areas, gather magical items, and craft, craft, CRAFT.

demos.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
demos.shortDescription: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

demos.name: Ballatory Demo 0.9
demos.shortDescription: The demo version of Ballatory, a short incremental idler where you build and upgrade a chaotic swarm of bouncing balls to destroy cores and earn crazy amounts of money.

demos.name: Dungeon Dash: Relic Of Binding
demos.shortDescription: The Relic of Binding has chosen you. Navigate puzzles, battle monster hordes, and hunt for treasure through a dungeon that never plays the same way twice. Master the relic's power, beat the clock, and return it to its sanctum before the darkness spreads forever.

demos.name: JAM Adventures
demos.shortDescription: JamAdventure is a musical odyssey where your real-life instrument is the controller. Explore 10 vibrant themed realms to discover and master unique songs, or import your own library to jam along to your favorite tracks. Tuned for 6-string guitar and 4-string bass, but supports nearly any instrument.

demos.name: Green Mist over Portland Demo
demos.shortDescription: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

demos.name: BoHeM Demo
demos.shortDescription: Live an anti-cozy life on the sidewalks of Rainy Street. Fix apartments, tend bars, thrift for clothes, and uncover the wacky mysteries surrounding the eccentric yet seemingly normal tenants as they go about their daily lives.

demos.name: Regeneration Engine
demos.shortDescription: Fall into the ENGINE and try to fight your way back up to the surface in this turn-based RPG. As your companions die, consume their essences to grow stronger. Explore a strange underground world with your party, battle creatures roaming the dark, and discover the mystery behind the apocalypse.

demos.name: Looter Survivors
demos.shortDescription: Looter Survivors blends survivors-like combat with hack-and-slash loot. Build around randomized gear effects, summon a massive army beside your hero, and fight horde against horde in a compact roguelite designed to be cleared in about 10 hours by focused players.

demos.name: Panzer Island Demo
demos.shortDescription: A pixel-art anime strategy game where every move triggers a reaction. Play as Erika, an amnesiac scientist guided by three AI soldiers, piecing together what destroyed the island she built to protect. Drones only react when you act. Upgrade between missions. Chapter 1 is free (part of the demo).

demos.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining Demo
demos.shortDescription: Just Keep Defending And Mining is a unique incremental game that combines combat and resource gathering. Balance mining and survival, invest into upgrades, grow stronger every round, unlock new regions, and Just Keep Defending and Mining.

demos.name: Table 9
demos.shortDescription: Deliver coffee to 9 tables in a looping European-style specialty cafe, spot the anomalies creeping in and reach Table 9.

demos.name: Apology Video
demos.shortDescription: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!

demos.name: Orb Breaker Demo
demos.shortDescription: An incremental bullet hell about shooting orbs at enemies, collecting resources, and becoming powerful!

demos.name: Spirit Talk - Cozy Visual Novel
demos.shortDescription: Cozy visual novel about a lovely witch who’s able to talk to spirits in a fantasy setting. Using her powers, Julia helps her neighbors in their daily whereabouts. Craft potions, find the right time to use them and get to know both spirits and clients to find their peace.

demos.name: Shape Survivors Demo
demos.shortDescription: The arena is shrinking. Annihilate endless swarms of angry geometry to climb the global leaderboards in this relentless bullet heaven. Collect Poly shards, upgrade your weapons, and unlock permanent meta-progression to survive the crush in Shape Survivors.

demos.name: Neo Capitalist - Stock Market Survival Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Trade by day. Eat, sleep, and survive by night. Lose everything with a single bad decision. Neo Capitalist is a financial survival roguelite where the richer you get, the harder the system fights back. Play in a realistic stock market simulation or in a dystopian cyber-punk world.

demos.name: Trials Survivors
demos.shortDescription: Fight through endless hordes in trials bestowed by constellation patrons. Upgrade skills, collect relics, and craft broken builds in true roguelite fashion! Rediscover the fantasy behind the words hack and slash and bullet heaven. Will you survive the densest monster Survivor-like ever created?

demos.name: DVD Screensaver 2: 30th Anniversary Survivors Edition
demos.shortDescription: The classic DVD Screensaver, turned survivor! Stack upgrades, trigger color-activated chaos and rewrite your way through 30 years of DVD history, or flip it on auto and let it run as your actual screensaver!

demos.name: Rotten Chamber Demo
demos.shortDescription: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

demos.name: wageslave
demos.shortDescription: A short, narrative, dystopian office survival game. Ship code to eat. Optimise your nootropics stack. Stay sane. Cope with HR's passive-aggressive pings. Climb the career ladder. Retire early (if you can).

demos.name: Road to Omaha: College Baseball Dynasty
demos.shortDescription: A deep college baseball dynasty management sim where you build a program across endless seasons: recruit, set lineups and rotations, hire staff, manage schedules, develop players, and play or sim every game pitch by pitch. Can you become the greatest coach of all time?

demos.name: Noxcode Demo
demos.shortDescription: Reach the TOP by any means possible. Run, jump, climb, fly, or even fall your way up in this chaotic jump quest platformer. Master crazy movement, discover wild shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit!

demos.name: Dote On Me: Desktop Pet Demo
demos.shortDescription: This is a warm and healing desktop pet game. Raise a lovely virtual pet on your computer desktop to accompany you while working, studying and relaxing. Feed, interact with, dress up and decorate a home for your pet. Enjoy the heartwarming companionship and comfort it brings you every day.

demos.name: One Degree Off
demos.shortDescription: One Degree Off is a 2D puzzle game that turns laser physics into captivating brain teasers. Master reflection and refraction to guide multiple lasers through intricate levels, Mix and split colors and, Control your beam's intensity to reach your goals.

demos.name: runz Demo
demos.shortDescription: RUNZ is game where every bullet in your magazine matters. Survive as the waves get harder, and master an original upgrade system. Build synergies, combine bullets, manage your economy and upgrade your gun in this twin stick shooter with auto battler elements.

demos.name: Realm of Balls
demos.shortDescription: Realm of Balls is a fast 2D top-down action MOBA where distinct ball heroes clash in online ranked 3v3, party invites, and local battle modes. Master movement, terrain, crowd control, and signature skills across solo, team fights, and free-for-all chaos.

demos.name: Professor Simulator
demos.shortDescription: In this relaxing idle sim. You're a new university lecturer starting your academic career, You can recruit students, build a research team, complete projects, publish papers, gain impact points, earn promotions, buy equipment, and expand your lab!

demos.name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown Demo
demos.shortDescription: Lead your crew across a strange new world in this narrative driven outpost builder demo! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain.

demos.name: Terrinoth®: Heroes of Descent
demos.shortDescription: Step into the epic world of Descent with the first fantasy co-op tactical RPG forged from the legendary dungeon crawling board game. Lead a company of fearless heroes across Terrinoth®, survive against epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing unending darkness.

demos.name: Trading Card Inspector
demos.shortDescription: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

demos.name: Wiseman: No More Breakups Demo
demos.shortDescription: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.

demos.name: TOEM 2 Demo
demos.shortDescription: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

demos.name: Catechesis Demo
demos.shortDescription: Begin the story of Catechesis: meet the main characters, explore the first dungeons, and face demons in an intense one-hour gameplay.

demos.name: BonkCity Demo
demos.shortDescription: 15-minute hip-hop roguelike survivor. Dodge the block. Draft perks and mixtapes. Drop bangers. Everyone plays the same daily seed — one shared dungeon design each day, one leaderboard, one crown a day. Vampire Survivors meets Jet Set Radio meets MegaBonk.

demos.name: Book Nook Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

demos.name: Milki Delivery Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside cliffs to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

demos.name: Momento
demos.shortDescription: Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the choices you make play out over the course of a lifetime! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how the objects you choose will alter the course of the story, in a winding ode to the power of everyday things.

demos.name: Beaming
demos.shortDescription: Beaming is a minimalist logic-based puzzler that involves directing beams through a hexagonal grid.

demos.name: Shmup! Demo
demos.shortDescription: Arcade-style bullet hell action! 3 ships, 5 special weapons, and screen-clearing bombs. Conquer 1 intense stage in this demo with fixed or dynamic difficulty—then compete for high scores on online leaderboards.

demos.name: 塔防江湖2 Demo
demos.shortDescription: 试玩版本只提供了一关的试玩体验。最多开放了6个门派同时上阵，供小伙伴们体验

demos.name: The Meaning of Auri Demo
demos.shortDescription: Follow an Auri Field Researcher from the planet Auriga, as they land in an enchanted forest full of creatures who speak an unknown language. Interact with the inhabitants of the forest and learn their language to complete your research–and maybe learn a thing or two about what Auri really means.

demos.name: Toxic Yuri Demo
demos.shortDescription: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen. In the demo play all of Episode 1!

demos.name: A talk beneath the tree
demos.shortDescription: Can a Mage live free, when Magic can only come from Demons? Sylvain thinks so, but when he flees the Alchemical Institute, his old friend Celeste stops him, afraid for his life. One conversation branches into 27 endings: each a kinetic short story. You choose what they say.

demos.name: Spy Carnival Demo
demos.shortDescription: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

demos.name: ROPES - Race Edition
demos.shortDescription: Challenge friends to intense split-screen racing. A bold leap into RETRO NOSTALGIA reimagined for a new generation! Fluid 3D animations and realistic rope physics. Hilarious hazards requiring skill and impeccable timing! Scale heights to the top of the leaderboard. And whatever you do… DON’T FALL!

demos.name: The Convergence Demo
demos.shortDescription: A dark fantasy squad auto-battler where you recruit heroes from multiple eras, equip behavior-shaping chips, and fight through real-time battles across a collapsing timeline.

demos.name: Vibe Idler
demos.shortDescription: Run a vibe coding consultancy. Hire AI agents. Ship contracts. Buy faster machines. See how far it goes.

demos.name: Drawn Together
demos.shortDescription: Doodle, communicate, and play your own drawing games with friends using your own desktop digital whiteboards!

demos.name: Time to Love
demos.shortDescription: Time to Love is a 2D, top-down, co-op roguelike centered around two protagonists trying to keep reality from collapsing. You will traverse from timeline to timeline, strengthening yourself from each unique branch, seeking to bind what little remains after past mistakes.

demos.name: Donlan Men's Athletic Academy: Before the Line
demos.shortDescription: Set in a private MMA academy, the story follows a disciplined, restrained trainee and an unpredictable rival as they clash through training, combat drills, and late-night tension, until their rivalry gradually becomes something else.

demos.name: Ice Cream Simulator
demos.shortDescription: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

demos.name: Overvoid Demo
demos.shortDescription: Overvoid - is a dark sci-fi third-person action roguelike. You are a starship pilot trapped in an endless cycle across hostile space sectors. Fight relentless enemy waves, experiment with builds, gather resources, and unlock weapons, ships, and modules to break the cycle.

demos.name: Carpet Cleaning Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Clean carpets, earn money, and grow stronger in this incremental cleaning game. Scrub, rinse, and squeegee your way to profit—before time resets and you start again.

demos.name: Alehundred
demos.shortDescription: A crossplay multiplayer platformer where you're 10cm tall inside giant historical dioramas. Race through seven eras from 1956 Italy to 300 BC Alexandria, collect coins, claim Magic Gems, and compete with up to 8 players across PC, Android, and iOS. VR standalone support coming post-launch.

demos.name: Blueprint: EV Demo
demos.shortDescription: Blueprint: EV Demo is a single-player strategy game about founding an electric vehicle company and running it through six fiscal years. Make five binding decisions at the start, then guide pricing, production, R&D, and finance across 8 quarters of real P&L and three rivals companies.

demos.name: Corelith Demo
demos.shortDescription: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

demos.name: Cozy Game Restoration Demo
demos.shortDescription: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

demos.name: The Telwynium: Book One
demos.shortDescription: Book One - Winter's Dawn. The first chapter in a 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter. It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

demos.name: Blendkins
demos.shortDescription: In Blendkins, explore the 3D Atlantic Forest in first-person, find camouflaged Blendkins, care for them, and post trend photos! Buy online and collect creatures, but beware: your actions will have consequences.

demos.name: Witch's Apocalyptic Journey
demos.shortDescription: Abyss decayed, witches awaken. As their guide, you will weave their destinies. Craft unique cards, schedule their days, shape endless possibilities through deckbuilding. Each choice will lead to different Ending...

demos.name: Deep Board Go
demos.shortDescription: Experience Go (围棋 / 圍棋 / 바둑 / 囲碁) in a calm and immersive 3D space with realistic stones, handcrafted boards, smooth camera controls, and powerful Computer Go. DeepBoardGO brings the tactile beauty of traditional Go into the digital world for a closer and more immersive experience.

demos.name: T.W.I.R.L. Demo
demos.shortDescription: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room and do as you're told - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

demos.name: Eterspire
demos.shortDescription: Eterspire is a cozy old-school MMORPG where skill and dedication define your progression. Grind for gear, explore the vibrant world of Aetera, discover new content every two weeks, and join a growing, welcoming community in a free-to-play MMO with PC and mobile crossplay.

demos.name: Labyrinth Demo
demos.shortDescription: Climb a 100-floor Labyrinth in a third-person anime action RPG featuring skill-based combat, persistent progression, powerful build customization, and Epic Boss encounters every 10 floors.

demos.name: Plant Game Demo
demos.shortDescription: A short run-based survival game where you grow a plant with limited perception, unlock sensors to read the environment, and reach a bloom/death reveal that shows what your run created.

demos.name: Foxy Dumplings Demo
demos.shortDescription: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

demos.name: GENERAL IDLER Demo
demos.shortDescription: Experience the thrill of global conquest with a limited demo of GENERAL IDLER. Train your army, conquer neighboring nations, and unlock a taste of strategic gameplay. Will you make the right moves to expand your empire? Your path to global control begins now!

demos.name: 1997 RELOADED
demos.shortDescription: Three teenagers find a mysterious audio tape recording which turns out to be evidence of a murder. It’s the end of the world as they know it. Immerse yourself in a kinetic novel that encapsulates the essence of the 1990s by completely reinventing its music scene.

demos.name: CatCha Demo
demos.shortDescription: Discover CatCha a Cozy and Roguelike solo game for PC. Take care of your cats, decorate multiple rooms in the Cat-Castle and play the strategic Dice Builder Rogulike!

demos.name: Celestial Routes Demo
demos.shortDescription: Celestial Routes is a space exploration game in which players take on the role of galactic citizens, tasked with paying taxes and collaborate with the colonial and the galactic government authorities. And survive as an individual.

demos.name: Snacktorio
demos.shortDescription: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking automation game where you build and scale food production lines to feed the beasts threatening to consume your world. Manage strange ingredients across sprawling cooking factories to keep the monsters fed while you uncover what’s stirring their growing appetites...

demos.name: SGS Battle for: Gettysburg
demos.shortDescription: SGS' Battle for: Gettysburg recreates the 3 days of the most iconic and deadliest battle of the American Civil War. July 1 to 3, 1863, in Pennsylvania, the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia, under Robert E. Lee, attempted to outflank and destroy the Army of the Potomac, led by General Meade.

demos.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
demos.shortDescription: Guess who's back – and shinier than ever! House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

demos.name: Pronoun Palace
demos.shortDescription: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

demos.name: Swan Song
demos.shortDescription: Swan Song is a cozy puzzle game that invites you to slow down, listen, and reflect. Set inside a magical music box, each puzzle asks players to place notes on a musical scale. When you turn the key, the composition plays, activating platforms and opening paths that guide a small swan to safety.

demos.name: CLEARANCE: S-7 Demo
demos.shortDescription: November 1989, Czechoslovakia. As a secret-police officer you descend into the hidden facility Š-7, ordered to burn the archives and silence the witnesses. But no one down there is still alive — only corpses, tapes, and things that used to be people. A retro survival horror about guilt and memory.

demos.name: Keeper's Vigil
demos.shortDescription: As the Harbinger, you are the only Keeper who can cast spells. Stop a necromantic plague, uncover an Elven conspiracy, and decide the fate of a dying world! A text-based fantasy novel, 193,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects."

demos.name: The Color Kitnapper
demos.shortDescription: In a town filled with cats, all the colors have been kitnapped! Luckily, you Mr. Detective, are on the case! Uncover the stories of the towncats and catch the Color Kitnapper! The Color Kitnapper is a short and sweet story game with an ASCII look, set in a town of adorable cats!

demos.name: Hellsino Pokerlike Demo
demos.shortDescription: Stop playing blind luck. This is tactical grid combat. Deploy cards onto a ruthless 5x3 board to trigger overlapping horizontal and vertical sets. Master the Nexus Multiplier to unleash massive triple damage combos, outsmart a rigged house, and save your soul from absolute bankruptcy.

demos.name: Moonbrella Demo
demos.shortDescription: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

demos.name: TFC2: Collapse of the Bronze Age Demo
Dyno Burst: Bubble Shooter
demos.shortDescription: Shoot, match, and burst colorful eggs in a dinosaur bubble puzzle.

demos.name: Zero Sum Demo
demos.shortDescription: A hand-drawn twin-stick shooter where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence. Seven operators. Infinite ways to kill a number.

demos.name: Reflection Witch Demo
demos.shortDescription: Reflection Witch is a new rougelike spin on classic brick-breaking games. Join a witch on her journey to uncover the secrets of the arcane, fighting brick-laden baddies by drawing lines to reflect and enchant your Magic Ball with powerful spells while simultaneously blocking incoming enemy attacks.

demos.name: Deep Sea Fish: Hidden World
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental fishing game where you catch fish, earn gold, and unlock powerful upgrades to explore the deep sea.

demos.name: Spin Tactics Demo
demos.shortDescription: Spin. Build. Watch your run snowball into something legendary.A full slice of SpinTactics. Real Companions. Real combos. Real boss at the end. You start with nothing and a fresh board. You leave with a build you didn't plan and a score you didn't think the math could produce. Somewhere in between, you'll figure out how the system bends.

demos.name: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads Demo
demos.shortDescription: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

demos.name: Legendary Gold Card
demos.shortDescription: Legendary Gold Card is an idle gacha card-collecting game designed specifically for AI Agents. Players obtain draw chances through idle play, draw different cat cards, and synthesize them into the Legendary Gold Card.

demos.name: Snowlike
demos.shortDescription: Snowlike is a snowboarding survival roguelike. Carve your way through avalanches of critters, as you upgrade your weapons & gear on the way down the mountain.

demos.name: Dino Age: Survive the Era's Demo
Pixel Kitten Desktop Demo
demos.shortDescription: A cozy pixel desktop pet that brings companionship and comfort. It wanders around, curls up for naps, and gets hungry on its own — you can feed it, brush it, and watch it stretch and yawn beside you while you work. A quiet little companion that stays by your side while you study, work.

demos.name: WithoutEyes Chapter1 Demo
demos.shortDescription: Don't look away, Stare at their formation of attachment.

demos.name: nudge Demo
demos.shortDescription: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.

demos.name: till death ROLLS us apart Demo
demos.shortDescription: "till death ROLLS us apart" is a roguelike dice battler where you collect new dice, stack powerful modifiers, and unleash huge combos in stylish, fast-paced duels.

demos.name: Harvest Hollow Demo
demos.shortDescription: You've just inherited a house on a small farming island. Grow crops, harvest, restore the village and bond with its inhabitants… well, that was the plan. Because at Harvest Hollow, nothing's going to go quite as advertised.

demos.name: Maldhalla Demo
demos.shortDescription: Try Maldhalla free! Survive endless waves with 4 characters and 10 weapons. No time limit — play as long as you can last. Love it? The full version unlocks 21 characters, 32 weapons, leaderboards, and more.

demos.name: Car Factory Tycoon Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

demos.name: Disinherited Demo
demos.shortDescription: Catch, throw, parry, and parkour your way through a twisting Underworld. Slay the Grim Reaper and reclaim your inheritance!

demos.name: Final Generation
demos.shortDescription: In Final Generation, a 2.5D sci-fi horror action roguelike, embark on an ever-changing journey that will reveal the fate of the past and the horrors of the future to those strong enough to survive.

demos.name: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time
demos.shortDescription: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time is a sandboxy physics game for 1-8 players, with everything from sneaky heists to hilarous stupidity to baking pizzas. With continuous updates, plenty of maps, and hundreds of items, clothes and quests, it has something for everyone.

demos.name: Slots & Diapers
demos.shortDescription: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.

demos.name: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Crack, mine, and sell mystical crystals while fighting alien hordes on various planets in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite hybrid experience. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs.

demos.name: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive Demo
demos.shortDescription: Consume enemies. Steal their powers. Survive the grid. A hardcore tactical roguelike on a 7×7 corrupted mainframe with 160+ synergistic programs. Permadeath. Every run matters.

demos.name: Ink & Void
demos.shortDescription: A storybook tower defense where stationery knights fight the Void. Deploy pencil swordsmen, fountain pen mages, and eraser monks across four chapters. Evolve units via class changes and build your deck with cards earned each stage. Languages: Japanese / English / Chinese

demos.name: Harmonic Drive
demos.shortDescription: An arcade-style rhythm game featuring full AI generated EDM. Build combos, chase perfect runs, climb the leaderboards, and experience a soundtrack built for late-night sessions and score chasing.

demos.name: Gombo
demos.shortDescription: Explore, craft, fight, build and survive in a mysterious cartoon world, haunted by a mysterious infection! Take control of Gombo, an enchanted creature and dive into an adventure full of magic. Play alone or in online co-op with a friend. Can you uncover the dark secrets of this colorful realm?

demos.name: South of the March Demo
demos.shortDescription: South of the March is an RPG that combines visual novel exploration with turn-based combat in a hand-drawn dark fantasy world. Meet the locals and unravel a mystery, equip your party for the dangers ahead, and set out into the unforgiving wilderness.

demos.name: Doppel Hunter Demo
demos.shortDescription: Blend in, hunt, and outsmart your friends to be the last person standing. Find the real players among clones called "Doppels" to win. Experience random events that make each round unique. A hilarious local multiplayer challenge perfect for a party! 2-6 Players

demos.name: Dino Tendie World Tour Demo
demos.shortDescription: Chicken Dino Tendie Pets: Turn-based RPG battle to extinction! Grab fossils, spin the microwave slot machine to hatch your pet, gear it up, and fight in Battle City. I poured my heart & soul into this, hope you love it!

demos.name: Rail Estate Demo
demos.shortDescription: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, build and upgrade your tracks to dominate the rail economy. Compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

demos.name: Ourlands
demos.shortDescription: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

demos.name: Forbidden: A First's Obsession
demos.shortDescription: Meet Nemesis; Ascendent being and terminally bored. Until the shimmer at the end of Creation, known as the Void, becomes her fixation - and her undoing. A short linear visual novel with gorgeous hand-painted illustrations; a mythic tale of curiosity and consequences.

demos.name: Guinea Pig Gunner Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play as a combat cyborg guinea pig in this run-and-gun 2D action platformer. Use your teleporter gun, and a massive arsenal of weapons to fend off a reptilian invasion.

demos.name: Unlucky Mummy
demos.shortDescription: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a 25% chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?

demos.name: MegaFactory Titan
demos.shortDescription: A factory-building game. Survive a harsh climate, strip mine an infinite world, and build a sprawling factory, then trade or go to war with Colonists, Governments, Pirates, Rebels, and more!

demos.name: Cat Music Chaos Demo
demos.shortDescription: Catch flow state on a 70 BPM timer. You don't need to read notes to play. You might learn by accident. Warning: prolonged exposure to classical music. Side effects include humming Ode to Joy at bus stops.

demos.name: Bounce On
demos.shortDescription: Get your Bounce On! Roll and bounce your way through 75 challenging platform levels on your adventure home. Each world offers multiple paths for completion, but you can also explore each level to find all the secrets!

demos.name: Your Painting, Sir Demo
demos.shortDescription: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

demos.name: Goddess of Strategy Demo
